title: Ruby: State-of-the-Art Potency Prediction across Discovery Regimes Using Learned Structural Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.27015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small-molecule drug discovery proceeds through repeated design-make-test-analyze cycles. The goal is often to maximize potency while keeping other properties within the ranges required for a viable therapeutic candidate. Compound prioritization places different demands on computational methods as drug discovery progresses from hit identification through hit-to-lead and lead optimization, with changing computational budgets and increasing amounts of on-target experimental data. We introduce Ruby, a Robust Universal Binding affinitY predictor that uses intermediate representations from the structural foundation model Pearl without requiring an explicit binding pose for every compound. Ruby is trained on proprietary data plus GenesisPotency-2026, an audited public-source potency training dataset released for academic and commercial use under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license with row-level provenance and audit annotations. translated_title: Ruby：利用学习到的结构表示在不同药物发现阶段实现最先进的药物效力预测
translated_abstract: 小分子药物发现通过反复的设计-合成-测试-分析循环进行，其目标通常是在保持其他性质处于可行治疗候选药物所需范围内的同时，最大化药物效力。随着药物发现从苗头化合物识别推进到先导化合物转化和先导化合物优化阶段，化合物优先级排序对计算方法提出了不同的要求，计算预算不断变化，靶向实验数据量也在不断增加。我们介绍了Ruby，一个鲁棒的通用结合亲和力预测器，它利用结构基础模型Pearl的中间表示，而无需为每个化合物提供显式的结合姿态。Ruby在专有数据以及GenesisPotency-2026上进行训练，后者是一个经过审计的公开来源药效训练数据集，以CC BY-SA 4.0许可证发布供学术和商业使用，并带有行级来源追溯和审计注释。Ruby实现了最高的……
tldr: Ruby是一个利用结构基础模型Pearl的中间表示、无需显式结合姿态的鲁棒通用结合亲和力预测器，通过专有数据与公开数据集GenesisPotency-2026训练，在药物发现的各个阶段均实现了最先进的药效预测。
en_tdlr: Ruby is a robust universal binding affinity predictor that leverages intermediate representations from the structural foundation model Pearl without requiring explicit binding poses, trained on proprietary data plus the public GenesisPotency-2026 dataset, achieving state-of-the-art potency prediction across all drug discovery regimes.
